title: NPC/Creature Reuse and Cross-System Adapters
objective: Prove player species can be consumed by NPC/creature/campaign/combat/social/exploration/crafting systems without collapsing species, creature definition, archetype and instance.
boundaries: MVPS-15 owns species-facing reuse/adaptation contracts and integration proof, not a second NPC/creature engine or duplicated species canon.
SpeciesDefinition remains the shared canonical species reference; NPC/Creature Definition, archetype/template and live instance identities remain distinct layers.
Adapters preserve exact-version species, lineage/form/adaptation and provenance references rather than copying or flattening species mechanics into NPC records.
Campaign, combat, social, exploration and crafting integrations consume shared owner contracts and remain projection/mapping seams rather than replacement domain engines.
Player-only creation/presentation concerns do not become NPC requirements unless an owner contract explicitly requires them.
MNCS-14 and MNCS-22 retain NPC/Creature composition/runtime authority; unresolved specialist dependencies remain explicit rather than invented.
Radical-species golden proof remains MVPS-16; MVPS-16 remains unauthorized until separately selected.
